## v1.3.2

### Reliability improvements

- Added a persistent last-known standings cache using Home Assistant storage.
- Cached standings now survive Home Assistant restarts and integration reloads.
- If the EuroLeague API is temporarily unavailable, the sensor keeps showing the last successfully loaded standings instead of becoming `unavailable`.
- Added `data_stale: true` when cached standings are being shown.
- Added endpoint-specific API error messages to make failures easier to diagnose in Home Assistant logs.
- Clubs and games endpoints are treated as supplemental data. If either fails, the main standings can still update and previous logo / points data is reused where possible.
- Added `partial_data` and `partial_errors` attributes when supplemental API data is temporarily unavailable.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/braticks/euroleague-standings/compare/v1.3.1...v1.3.2
